integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 0811.2781 lists version 1 on 2008-11-17.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival anchor lists primary MSC 14N15 and studies symplectic isotropic Grassmannians.
integrity.proof_basis: The projective degree is reconstructed from the type-C Weyl dimension formula; the valuation then follows symbolically from Legendre's formula.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns complex symplectic isotropic Grassmannians in their Pluecker embeddings.
Only the two-adic valuation is simplified to a binary digit-sum formula.
The maximal Lagrangian boundary is a known special case and is not claimed as new.
An unindexed representation-theory or Schubert-calculus source could contain the same valuation simplification.
title: Exact two-adic valuation of Pluecker degrees of symplectic Grassmannians
